title: Backup Codes
summary: Makes users save their recovery codes and type one back before continuing, so they aren't locked out later by codes they never kept.
description: Continue unlocks only after the codes are downloaded, printed or copied (or all three with require="all"); then one code must be typed back, with paste refused and look-alike characters forgiven, to show the saved copy is readable.
catches: Moving on without saving the codes by download, print or copy
A saved copy that can't be read back, by asking for one code
Paste into the check field (refused unless allowPaste)
Leaving the page before finishing (beforeunload warning, on by default)
limits: It knows a download, print or copy was started, not that the file was kept
Typing one code back proves one code was readable, not that all were saved
a11y: Codes are an ordered list labelled by the title; save buttons use aria-pressed
The still-locked Continue uses aria-disabled with aria-describedby to what is left to do
The check field has a <label>, aria-invalid on a wrong length and an aria-live hint
server: Store only hashes of the codes, make each one single-use, and rate-limit recovery attempts on the server.
stops: Locked out with unsaved backup codes
